summary: Iteration 4 final verification: TableTaap rebrand + auth flow (login/signup/change-pin/recover-pin) + theme toggle + gst_rate empty default. Backend pytest: 17/18 passing (1 unrelated failure due to user-edited categories — categories 'Starters/Drinks/etc' were deleted by manager prior to this run; not a backend bug). Frontend Playwright: 30/30 checks passing — login page (logo, header 'Login', empty PIN placeholder, Forgot PIN dialog, Create-account link), wrong PIN 401 → error, PIN 4321 redirects to /manager, sidebar logo + all 5 full-text labels, topbar clock HH:MM AM/PM (no seconds), Bill modal renders with restaurant_name='Prem Sai Cafe' and CGST/SGST lines (gst_rate=12.5 in DB), Settings has theme toggle (data-theme dark↔light + localStorage tt_theme persists), Change PIN form, Recover via mobile form, GST input is type=number with 'Leave empty for no tax line' hint, Sales Today logout AlertDialog with YES/NO, Customer page uses /logo.png and shows 'Not Available' badges.

minor.issue: Backend filters None from update dict — once a numeric gst_rate is set, sending {gst_rate: null} cannot clear it (the field is dropped). Manager cannot un-set GST via API/UI without DB intervention. Consider treating explicit null as 'unset' (use $unset or accept None).

issues: Clock still renders lowercase 'am/pm' (e.g. '08:23 pm'). Spec asks for 'AM/PM' uppercase. Carried over from iteration 2 — apply .toUpperCase() or explicit Intl.DateTimeFormat with hour12:true.
A menu item titled 'kndfbkefb' (₹328) with a human face photo is currently visible in /customer (live data, not a bug). Manager should clean this up; mention only as awareness.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Force topbar clock to uppercase AM/PM for spec compliance.
(Optional) Allow PUT /api/settings to clear gst_rate when explicit null is sent (currently None is filtered out, so a previously-set GST rate cannot be cleared via UI).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_settings() builds `update = {k:v for k,v in body.model_dump().items() if v is not None}`. This means Optional[float] fields like gst_rate cannot be unset once assigned. Consider tri-state: missing = ignore, null = unset (use $unset), value = set.
auth status endpoint exposes manager_name and restaurant_name without authentication — acceptable for the unauth login screen UX but be aware this leaks brand identity to anonymous callers.
PIN stored in plaintext in MongoDB (db.settings.manager_profile.pin). Acceptable for a 4-digit PIN MVP but worth flagging — at minimum hash with bcrypt, or document this as accepted risk.
recover-pin only verifies last-7 digits of contact_number with no rate limiting — a brute-force could reset the PIN with sufficient guesses. Add a simple attempt counter / 60s cooldown.
/api/auth/signup and /api/auth/login return tokens but no other endpoint validates them; the API is effectively unauthenticated. Document this limitation or add a simple bearer-token check on writes.
